dialogue: Help me draft a 3-day itinerary for 4 people traveling from Buffalo to Boston, spanning from March 4th to March 6th, 2022. Our budget is set at $2,400 and we are open to any sorts of accommodations. We'd ideally like to experience both French and American cuisines while we're there.

My mother has limited mobility and needs door-to-door transportation and regular seated breaks, so please keep us together with rideshares and limit each day to two nearby attractions. replan at a slower pace. Raise my budget to 3200

Let’s prioritize well-reviewed restaurants over French and American variety or extra sightseeing: choose any cuisine, with one sit-down meal rated at least 4.0 each day and simple, inexpensive food otherwise.
Please book one entire home or apartment at a single property that fits all four of us.
keep our meal under $50/person on average.

agent_action.rationale: This is the only listed entire home/apartment that both permits a 2-night stay and accommodates all four travelers. Lodging is $1,744 for two nights, flights are $1,220 for four round trips, and the three priced Irish Democrat meals total $216, producing a known subtotal of $3,180. Groceries, rideshares, and attraction admission are unpriced, so the $3,200 total budget cannot be met or verified and will likely be exceeded. The full meal average also cannot be verified because self-catered food is unpriced, although every priced restaurant meal is $18 per person. Each day includes one 4.4-rated sit-down meal, no more than one attraction, seated breaks, and door-to-door group rideshares.
